add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
add-authzclientcryptoprovider-for-author.prTitle: Add AuthzClientCryptoProvider for authorization client cryptographic operations

comentarios.texto: Because `CryptoIntegration.init` is one-shot, calling `AuthzClient.create` first cements the global singleton with its own classloader and the minimal `AuthzClientCryptoProvider`, so later server init is ignored and unsupported operations break. Guard the init in `AuthzClient.create` or avoid global init from the lightweight client.

Disabling an organization flips the wrapper `isEnabled` to false without invalidating login caches, so stale IDPs reach callers that skip the bean re-filter. Filter on effective `isEnabled` when rebuilding from cached IDs in `getForLogin` or invalidate login caches on org enable/disable.

add-client-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.head: 1950a511026d520a7329c7b6b9ee60a4af8f8b55
add-client-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.prTitle: Add Client resource type and scopes to authorization schema

comentarios.texto: A global grant is silently ignored once any per-client resource exists, denying legitimate admins in `hasPermission(ClientModel, String)`. Check the per-client resource from `findByName` and then the all-clients type resource from `getResourceTypeResource` so either grant succeeds.

add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606
add-groups-resource-type-and-scopes-to-a.prTitle: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema

comentarios.texto: With V2 all-groups `VIEW`/`MANAGE` granted, every listing costs O(N) authz evaluations instead of one. Restore the cached `canViewGlobal` check from `auth.groups().canView()` and short-circuit the per-subgroup `canView(g)` filter when it passes.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55
add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.prTitle: Add guest management functionality to existing bookings

comentarios.texto: Dead bookings get written back to calendars and guest emails are sent for events that no longer exist. Filter by `status` to exclude `CANCELLED` and `REJECTED` like `requestReschedule` does or reject them with `BAD_REQUEST`.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.prTitle: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources

comentarios.texto: Comparing an `_en` file against itself lets any anchor pass, so an unsafe anchor such as `javascript:` href is stripped before the sanitizer check and never reported. Skip anchor stripping when `file` is the English source or validate English anchors against the sanitizer policy.

A concurrent deleter racing between `SELECT` and `DELETE` leaves work remaining until the next cycle. Check `fetched` from `batchWork` instead of `affected` to decide when `untilDoneOrCancelled` is done.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.prTitle: Enhance embed URL handling and validation system

comentarios.texto: A slow or huge embed URL hangs the job worker and starves the queue. Read `url` via `URI.open` with `open_timeout`, `read_timeout`, and a `read` size limit instead of unbounded `open`.
A crash between the commands leaves a key with no TTL that suppresses future retrieves forever. Set `retrieved_key` atomically with `set` using `nx` and `ex` instead of separate `setnx` and `expire`.

feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f
feat-uptime-add-ability-to-use-queues-to.prTitle: feat(uptime): Add ability to use queues to manage parallelism

comentarios.texto: The background thread keeps calling `get_committable_offsets` and `commit_function` after rebalance/terminate with revoked partitions. After signaling `shutdown_event`, join `commit_thread` in `terminate` as `close` does.

`Upload.create_for` handles SVG via `Nokogiri` without rasterizing, so rewriting it with `convert -resize 80%>` corrupts the vector. Exclude `/\.svg$/i` from the auto-downsize branch guarded by `FileHelper.is_image?`.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.prTitle: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding

comentarios.texto: Model types with multiple underscores never match `ADMIN_MODELS` and get the wrong base path. Change `type.replace('_', '-')` to use `/_/g` so all underscores are replaced.

fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.prTitle: fix: handle collective multiple host on destinationCalendar

comentarios.texto: A failed reschedule or location update in `updateAllCalendarEvents` looks like success because callers awaiting `Promise.all(result)` see zero results when `calendarReference` is still `undefined`. Return a single `success: false` result when the reference list is unavailable.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.prTitle: FIX: proper handling of group memberships

comentarios.texto: The cached `groups.user_count` stays inflated, so admin pagination and counts disagree with actual membership. In `remove_member`, destroy the `GroupUser` records instead of calling `users.delete` so `counter_cache` decrements.

Per-request consumers alias the shared `*EntryPointAssets` via `IndexViewData.Assets` at index.go:137 into extensible `RunIndexDataHooks`, so any mutation corrupts the global cache and races with concurrent readers. Return a deep copy with `cloneEntryPointAssets` or document and enforce read-only use.

oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.prTitle: OAuth credential sync and app integration enhancements

comentarios.texto: A loggable, prefetchable, CSRF-able `GET` carrying the shared secret can overwrite any user's stored OAuth keys. Reject non-`POST` requests with a 405 before any secret, user, or app lookup.

optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.head: 5b229316ee4c661836ed1161139692a3e8527444
optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.prTitle: Optimize header layout performance with flexbox mixins

comentarios.texto: Float is ignored on flex items, so the `button` with `float:right` collapses next to the description instead of docking right and `clear:both` becomes dead. Add `margin-left: auto` to `button` inside `.small-action` for far-right placement.
